features.title: A sofa that feels as good as it looks
features.text: With its premium fabric upholstery in soothing camel and taupe tones, the Cresco sofa combines a soft, luxurious feel with modern aesthetics that complement any living space.

features.title: Built for lasting strength
features.text: Made with a sturdy solid wood frame, this sofa provides strong support and ensures it can stand up to years of daily use without losing its charm.

features.title: Armrests with quiet elegance
features.text: The beautifully crafted wooden armrests add a touch of warmth and refinement to your space, creating the perfect balance of practicality and sophistication.

features.title: Cushions designed for your comfort
features.text: Plush, supportive cushions adapt to your posture, ensuring every moment spent lounging is cosy, comfortable, and relaxing.

features.title: Spacious seating for family and friends
features.text: With generous seating across all six spots, Cresco brings everyone together—comfortably, and without crowding.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
